title: Calling George Noory's show while Bob Hastings was the guest

tellings.quote: Hastings was one I had talked to when I called George Dory

plain: Richard Barth, a former guard at a US nuclear missile site who says he was abducted by aliens, tells Michels that he first talked to the researcher Bob Hastings by calling in to Coast to Coast AM, the late-night radio show about the paranormal hosted by George Noory, while Hastings was the guest. Barth tells it from his own experience, as the way his story first reached someone who collected such accounts.
